# @fyit/crouton-collab

> Real-time collaboration with Yjs CRDTs — WebSocket rooms, presence, and cross-client collection sync

AI hint: use when app needs real-time collaboration or cross-client list sync

## Components

- `CollabCursors`: Remote cursor overlay rendering for canvas/editor content
- `CollabEditingBadge`: "X editing" badge for collection list items via HTTP poll
- `CollabIndicator`: Combined status and presence for toolbars — status dot plus user avatars
- `CollabPresence`: Stacked user avatars with overflow indicator (+N)
- `CollabStatus`: Connection status indicator with colored dot and optional label

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useCollabConnection`
- `useCollabEditor`
- `useCollabLocalizedContent`
- `useCollabPresence`
- `useCollabRoomUsers`
- `useCollabSync`
- `useCollectionSyncSignal`
- `useFormCollabPresence`
